headline: House measure to end the 2003 national emergency on stabilizing Iraq was voted down.
what_it_does: This resolution would have ended the national emergency that President George W. Bush declared on May 22, 2003, about the stabilization of Iraq. A national emergency lets the President use special legal powers, such as economic and financial measures, tied to that situation. Ending it would have taken away the legal basis for actions taken under that emergency. The House voted it down on July 18, 2023.

who_it_affects.group: The President and executive branch agencies
who_it_affects.how: They would have lost the special emergency powers tied to the 2003 Iraq declaration.

who_it_affects.group: People and businesses covered by rules issued under the Iraq emergency
who_it_affects.how: Rules and restrictions based on this emergency would have no longer applied to them.
